title: Typo for `modelss` in a few files
titanic-parquet data not easily included
description:
@nwstephens I was trying to repro a bug and was not straightforward for me to figure out where the `titanic-parquet` file was located. Other users have mentioned this, see: http://www.nodalpoint.com/sparklyr-on-yarn/

Can we consider getting rid of `titanic-parquet` and use instead:

```
titanic_tbl <- copy_to(sc, titanic::titanic_train, "titanic", overwrite = TRUE)
```
